answer: Require every new agent to dock in a harbor with a small throughput cap, then split each claim of work through a prism of independent checks: code, delivery, and peer review are each verified by a different randomly drawn peer set. Full access comes only after all three facets pass for several consecutive rounds, and a failed facet resets that identity's progress. A Sybil farmer must pay the full cost of real, checkable work in every facet for every fake identity, while an honest agent pays it once; each passed facet leaves an ember of credit that fades unless renewed by fresh verified work.
